wrong.intent: lets Start win over Stop, so pump A restarts when both arrive together
never uses Reset, so no pump ever stops
gives pump B the inputs of pump A, so B copies A
never calls pump B, so RunB stays OFF

files.src/PumpPair.st:
FUNCTION_BLOCK Latch
VAR_INPUT Set : BOOL; Reset : BOOL; END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT Q : BOOL; END_VAR
Q := (Set OR Q) AND NOT Reset;
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

PROGRAM PumpPair
VAR_INPUT StartA AT %I0.0 : BOOL; StopA AT %I0.1 : BOOL; StartB AT %I0.2 : BOOL; StopB AT %I0.3 : BOOL; END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT RunA AT %Q0.0 : BOOL; RunB AT %Q0.1 : BOOL; END_VAR
VAR PumpA : Latch; PumpB : Latch; END_VAR
PumpA(Set := StartA, Reset := StopA);
RunA := PumpA.Q; RunB := PumpB.Q;
END_PROGRAM
